name: UP Scholarship
key_benefits: Fee reimbursement and monthly maintenance allowance for post-matric and pre-matric studies.
summary: Online scholarship and fee reimbursement services for eligible students studying in recognized institutions in Uttar Pradesh.
likely_eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh enrolled in a recognized school, college, or university.
Family annual income must be within government prescribed limits (normally up to ₹2 Lakhs for General/OBC/Minority, ₹2.5 Lakhs for SC/ST).
The student must have satisfactory attendance and valid academic enrollment in an eligible course.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card or accepted identity proof
Income Certificate issued by competent authority
Caste Certificate (for SC, ST, OBC applicants)
Domicile / Residence Certificate of Uttar Pradesh
Bank passbook linked to Aadhaar (active NPCI mapping)
Previous year academic marksheet
Current course fee receipt and admission enrollment number
steps: Visit the official UP Scholarship portal (scholarship.up.gov.in).
Register under Student section (Pre-Matric, Post-Matric Inter, or Post-Matric Other than Inter).
Log in with your registration ID and fill in personal, academic, and bank information.
Upload mandatory scanned documents (photograph, certificates).
Submit the preliminary application, check the draft, and lock the final submission.
Print the final submission copy and submit it to your educational institution with document proofs.

name: Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY)
key_benefits: Full government funding for undergraduate tuition fees at medical, engineering, law, and degree colleges.
summary: Madhya Pradesh state government scheme that pays the complete academic fees of meritorious students who score high in 12th board exams.
likely_eligibility: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
Scored 70% or above in MP Board 12th exam, or 85% or above in CBSE/ICSE 12th exam.
Total annual family income must not exceed ₹6 Lakhs.
Secured admission in an eligible engineering (JEE rank under 1.5 Lakh), medical (NEET), law (CLAT), or recognized government degree course.
common_documents: Samagra ID and Aadhaar Card
MP Domicile Certificate (Mool Niwas Praman Patra)
Income Certificate showing annual family income below ₹6 Lakhs
Class 10th and 12th marksheets
Entrance exam scorecard and allotment letter (JEE / NEET / CLAT)
College fee receipt and bank account linked to Aadhaar
steps: Open the MP State Scholarship 2.0 portal (scholarshipportal.mp.nic.in).
Register with your Samagra ID and create an applicant profile.
Choose Mukhyamantri Medhavi Vidyarthi Yojana (MMVY) from the scheme list.
Enter course admission details, entrance exam rank, and family income details.
Upload necessary verification certificates.
Submit the form online and submit a hard copy to your college nodal officer for verification.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
key_benefits: Scholarship of ₹12,000 per annum (₹1,000/month) for classes IX to XII.
summary: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to arrest the dropout rate of meritorious students from economically weaker sections at class VIII.
likely_eligibility: Student studying as regular student in Class IX in a Government, Local body or Government-aided school.
Must have scored at least 55% marks or equivalent grade in Class VIII examination (50% for SC/ST).
Parental annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹3,50,000 per annum.
Must clear the State level NMMSS selection test conducted at class VIII.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card of student linked with bank account
Class VIII marksheet
Parental income certificate issued by competent authority
Caste certificate and disability certificate if applicable
School bonafide student certificate
steps: Appear and qualify for the State Level NMMSS exam held in Class VIII.
After clearing, visit the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
Register with Aadhaar and academic credentials on NSP.
Select National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme and fill application.
Verify details and submit for school and district level verification.

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
key_benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each.
summary: Central sector scheme providing income support to all landholding farmer families across India to meet agriculture and domestic needs.
likely_eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names.
Aadhaar authentication and e-KYC are mandatory.
Exclusions apply to institutional landholders, income tax payers, serving/retired government employees, and constitutional post holders.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card linked to mobile number
Land ownership records (Khata/Khasra/Khatauni/ROR)
Bank account linked with Aadhaar with Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) enabled
Mobile number for OTP authentication
steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in).
Click on Farmers Corner and select New Farmer Registration.
Enter Aadhaar number and mobile number, verify with OTP.
Enter state, district, sub-district, village, and land record details.
Complete mandatory e-KYC using OTP or biometric verification at CSC.
Check payment and beneficiary status on the portal anytime.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
key_benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks at nominal premium rates (1.5% to 2% for food crops).
summary: National crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss or damage arising from natural calamities, pests and diseases.
likely_eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers.
Both loanee and non-loanee farmers are eligible.
Must apply within the specified seasonal cut-off date for Kharif or Rabi crops.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card
Land revenue records (ROR/Land Possession Certificate/Sowing Certificate)
Bank passbook showing active account details
Tenancy agreement/declaration if tenant farmer
steps: Visit the official PMFBY portal (pmfby.gov.in) or visit nearest bank/CSC/Agriculture office.
Register as farmer and select season (Kharif/Rabi) and notified crop.
Fill in survey number and sown area details.
Pay nominal premium online or through banking channel.
Obtain crop insurance policy receipt and policy number.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM-JAY
key_benefits: Cashless health insurance cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.
summary: World's largest government-funded health assurance scheme covering over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families across public and empanelled private hospitals, with Ayushman Vay Vandana card for seniors aged 70+.
likely_eligibility: Families identified based on Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) deprivation criteria or active NFSA ration card lists.
Senior citizens aged 70 and above are also covered under Ayushman Vay Vandana Card irrespective of income.
No cap on family size, age, or gender.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card or valid Government photo identity proof
Ration Card / PM-JAY Family ID / Ration card linking family members
Active mobile number for verification
steps: Visit the official portal (beneficiary.nha.gov.in) or download Ayushman App.
Enter mobile number, choose Beneficiary, and verify with OTP.
Search family using State, Scheme (PM-JAY), District, and Ration Card / Aadhaar number.
Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or facial recognition.
Download and print the Ayushman Card (Golden Card) for instant cashless treatment.

name: MGNREGA
key_benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of wage employment per financial year to rural adult household members willing to do unskilled manual work.
summary: Flagship legal guarantee ensuring the right to work for rural households, providing statutory wages and unemployment allowances if work is not given within 15 days.
likely_eligibility: Adult members of any rural household willing to do unskilled manual work.
Must reside within the local Gram Panchayat area.
Must be a citizen of India.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card and proof of age
Proof of rural residence (Ration Card, Voter ID)
Joint/individual photograph of household adult members
Bank or Post Office savings account passbook
steps: Submit application to the local Gram Panchayat verbally or in writing.
Gram Panchayat verifies residence and issues a Job Card within 15 days.
Submit written application for work specifying the period and dates required.
The Panchayat assigns work within 15 days of application receipt.
Wages are transferred directly to bank account via DBT.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
key_benefits: Credit-linked subsidy of 15% to 35% of project cost for setting up new micro-enterprises (up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 Lakh for services).
summary: Credit-linked government subsidy scheme to generate self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
likely_eligibility: Any individual above 18 years of age.
At least VIII standard pass for projects costing above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing and ₹5 Lakh in service sector.
Self Help Groups, institutions registered under Societies Registration Act are also eligible.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
Detailed Project Report (DPR) of the proposed business
Special category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Ex-Servicemen) for higher subsidy
Education/qualification certificates and EDP training certificate
steps: Visit the KVIC PMEGP portal (kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal).
Click on Application for New Unit and fill personal and project details.
Select financing bank branch and upload DPR, Aadhaar, and category certificates.
Submit application; DLTFC reviews and forwards to the financing bank.
Bank sanctions loan; complete EDP training and receive government margin money subsidy.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
key_benefits: High government small-savings interest rate (8.2%), Section 80C tax deduction, and complete tax exemption on interest and maturity.
summary: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao initiative small-savings scheme to build a financial corpus for the higher education and marriage of girl children.
likely_eligibility: Account can be opened by parent or legal guardian for a girl child from birth up to 10 years of age.
Only one account per girl child and maximum two accounts in a family (three in case of twins/triplets).
Minimum deposit ₹250 per year, maximum ₹1,50,000 per financial year.
common_documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Identity and address proof of the guardian (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID)
Photographs of guardian and girl child
steps: Visit nearest Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.
Fill Sukanya Samriddhi Account opening form (Form-1).
Attach girl child's birth certificate and guardian KYC documents.
Deposit initial amount (minimum ₹250).
Collect passbook containing account number and details.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
key_benefits: Direct cash benefit of ₹5,000 in two installments for the first child, and ₹6,000 in one installment for second child if girl child.
summary: Maternity benefit program compensating wage loss and improving health-seeking behavior and nutrition among pregnant and lactating mothers.
likely_eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first or second living child.
Must belong to socially/economically disadvantaged categories (e.g. SC/ST, women holding BPL ration cards, EWS, PMJAY beneficiaries).
Women in regular employment with Central/State Govt or PSUs are excluded.
common_documents: Mother and husband's Aadhaar Card
Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card with ANC registration dates
Aadhaar-seeded bank account details of beneficiary
Category or eligibility verification certificate (Ration card, EWS, etc.)
steps: Register pregnancy at nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or approved health facility within 570 days of LMP.
Beneficiary can also self-register on the PMMVY portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in).
Fill Application Form 1A with MCP Card details and bank information.
Upload necessary verification documents.
Cash incentive is directly credited to beneficiary bank account via DBT.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
key_benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh in rural areas, or interest subsidy up to ₹2.67 Lakh on home loans in urban areas.
summary: Housing for All scheme providing pucca houses with basic amenities (water, sanitation, electricity) to homeless families and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses.
likely_eligibility: Families having no pucca house in their name anywhere in India.
Rural beneficiaries identified through SECC 2011 and Awas+ priority lists verified by Gram Sabha.
Urban beneficiaries categorized under EWS (income up to ₹3 Lakh), LIG (income up to ₹6 Lakh).
common_documents: Aadhaar Card of all household members
Bank passbook linked to Aadhaar (DBT active)
Land ownership/possession document or Patta
Income certificate and photograph of current dwelling
steps: For Rural (PMAY-G): Eligible families are enlisted by Gram Panchayat via Awas+ mobile app and geo-tagged.
For Urban (PMAY-U): Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or nearest CSC under Citizen Assessment.
Enter Aadhaar number, personal details, current address, and bank account information.
Local municipality conducts physical inspection and verification.
Funds are released in geo-tagged construction stages directly to bank account.

name: Old Age Pension (Vridhavastha Pension)
key_benefits: Monthly social pension of ₹1,000 (transferred quarterly as ₹3,000) directly into the beneficiary's bank account.
summary: State social welfare pension providing financial dignity and security to destitute elderly citizens of Uttar Pradesh.
likely_eligibility: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh aged 60 years or above.
Applicant must be living below the poverty line (annual family income up to ₹46,080 in rural areas and ₹56,460 in urban areas).
Applicant should not be receiving any other government pension.
common_documents: Age proof (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, or Medical Age Certificate)
Income Certificate issued by competent Tehsil authority
Domicile / Residence Certificate of Uttar Pradesh
Bank passbook details with Aadhaar-seeded NPCI account
Passport size photograph
steps: Open the official UP Social Welfare Pension portal (sspy-up.gov.in).
Select Old Age Pension (वृद्धावस्था पेंशन) and click on Apply Online.
Select District, Tehsil, and rural/urban area, and enter personal details.
Enter bank account and income certificate application number and certificate ID.
Upload passport photograph and age/income proof documents.
Submit the final form, print acknowledgment, and track status with registration number.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
key_benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month after attaining 60 years of age.
summary: Government-backed pension scheme aimed at creating a universal social security system for all Indians, especially the poor and unorganized sector workers.
likely_eligibility: Any citizen of India between 18 and 40 years of age.
Must have a savings bank account linked with Aadhaar and mobile number.
Individuals who are income tax payers are not eligible to join APY.
common_documents: Savings Bank account / Post Office account passbook
Aadhaar Card for identity and address verification
Mobile number for receiving regular transaction alerts
steps: Approach the bank branch or post office where you hold a savings bank account.
Fill the Atal Pension Yojana subscriber registration form.
Select monthly pension slab (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and premium auto-debit frequency.
Provide nominee details and spouse information.
Ensure monthly balance for auto-debit; receive PRAN acknowledgment slip.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
key_benefits: Affordable working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy.
summary: Central micro-credit scheme to empower street vendors and hawkers to resume their livelihoods and build credit history with cashback incentives for digital transactions.
likely_eligibility: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020.
Possessing Certificate of Vending / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs).
Vendors from surrounding peri-urban/rural areas vending in geographic limits of ULBs with Letter of Recommendation (LoR).
common_documents: Aadhaar Card and mobile number linked with Aadhaar
Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from local body
Active savings bank account passbook
steps: Visit the official PM SVANidhi portal (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in) or visit nearest CSC/bank.
Verify mobile number with OTP and check vendor survey status/LoR.
Fill online loan application form and select lending institution.
Upload Aadhaar and Certificate of Vending.
Lender processes and disburses loan amount directly to bank account within days.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
key_benefits: Collateral-free institutional loans up to ₹10 Lakh in three categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh).
summary: Scheme providing funding to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises to start or expand business activities without pledging collateral.
likely_eligibility: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for a non-farm sector income generating activity.
Small manufacturing units, shopkeepers, fruit/vegetable vendors, artisans, and service sector units.
Applicant must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution.
common_documents: Identity and residence proof (Aadhaar, Voter ID, Passport, PAN Card)
Proof of business address and enterprise registration certificate if applicable
Last 6 months bank statement
Quotations for machinery or items to be purchased
steps: Prepare a business proposal and identify loan category (Shishu, Kishore, Tarun).
Visit udyamimitra.in portal or approach any commercial bank, RRB, MFI, or NBFC.
Fill the Mudra loan application form with personal and business details.
Submit required KYC, business quotations, and financial documents.
Bank evaluates proposal and sanctions loan with Mudra Debit Card for working capital.

name: Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra)
key_benefits: Official legal document establishing family income required for scholarships, fee concessions, government welfare schemes, and subsidies.
summary: A certificate issued by the Revenue Department / Sub-Divisional Magistrate verifying an individual's or family's annual income from all sources.
likely_eligibility: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Uttar Pradesh.
The applicant or head of household must declare genuine income sources with supporting documentary evidence.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card or voter ID card
Self-declaration certificate (Swaprameet Ghoshna Patra)
Salary slip / Form 16 / Agricultural land revenue receipt or municipal ward member report
Ration card or electricity bill for address verification
Passport size photograph
steps: Open the official UP e-District citizen portal (edistrict.up.gov.in) or visit Jan Seva Kendra (CSC).
Register as citizen on Citizen Service (eSathi) portal.
Select Revenue Department and choose Income Certificate (आय प्रमाण पत्र).
Fill applicant name, father/husband name, address, family members, and declared income.
Upload photograph, self-declaration form, and ration card.
Pay portal application fee (nominal ₹15) and note down the application number for status tracking.

name: Caste Certificate (Jati Praman Patra)
key_benefits: Official certificate certifying caste/category status for reservation in government jobs, education admissions, and welfare quotas.
summary: Document issued by the competent revenue authority certifying that an applicant belongs to a recognized Scheduled Caste, Scheduled Tribe, or Other Backward Class.
likely_eligibility: The applicant must be a resident of Uttar Pradesh belonging to a notified SC, ST, or OBC category.
For OBC non-creamy layer certificates, income criteria within the prescribed threshold must be verified.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card and residence proof
Swaprameet Ghoshna Patra (Self-declaration form)
Caste proof of father or family member (prior caste certificate or land record mentioning caste)
Passport size photograph
steps: Visit the UP e-District or eSathi portal (edistrict.up.gov.in).
Select Caste Certificate service (Separate options for Hindi / English certificate).
Fill in applicant details, caste, sub-caste, and permanent address.
Upload passport photograph, self-declaration, and family caste proof.
Pay standard processing fee and submit.
Lekhpal and Tehsildar conduct inquiry and issue digitally signed certificate within 15-20 days.

name: Domicile / Residence Certificate (Niwas Praman Patra)
key_benefits: Conclusive legal proof of permanent residence required for state quota admissions, government jobs, and regional welfare benefits.
summary: Official certificate issued by the Revenue Department validating that an applicant is a permanent bona fide resident of the state.
likely_eligibility: The applicant must have resided continuously in Uttar Pradesh for a minimum of 3 years, or be born in UP.
Must possess valid local address proof.
common_documents: Aadhaar Card or Voter ID card
Self-declaration certificate
Electricity bill, water bill, or registered rent/house deed
School leaving certificate or educational records proving duration of stay in UP
Passport size photograph
steps: Visit the UP e-District / eSathi portal (edistrict.up.gov.in).
Select Niwas Praman Patra (निवास प्रमाण पत्र) from the service catalogue.
Enter personal particulars, duration of residence at current address, and reason for application.
Upload photo, self-declaration, and residence proof documents.
Submit the form and pay portal fees.
Download digitally signed certificate upon approval by Tehsildar.
